name: What size bathroom addition adds the most value?

mainEntity.name: Is a half bath, three-quarter bath, or full bath the best investment?
mainEntity.text: Is a half bath, three-quarter bath, or full bath the best investment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best value comes from adding the type of bathroom that solves the home’s biggest functional gap. If the house lacks a guest bath near the main living area, a half bath can deliver strong convenience in a small footprint. If the home is short on showers, a full bath usually has more impact because it supports daily family use and broadens resale appeal. Three-quarter baths can be a useful compromise when space is limited but a shower is still needed. Value tends to be highest when the bath is well placed, fully permitted, and designed to feel natural to the floor plan. In Los Angeles neighborhoods, buyers often respond well to layouts that improve privacy and reduce morning bottlenecks. The highest-return choice is usually the one that makes the home function better without overbuilding for the property’s size.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best value usually comes from the type of bathroom the home is missing. The most valuable addition is one that improves the bedroom-to-bath ratio and fits the layout naturally.
